example.title: Montage Laguna Beach resort (2003), 30801 South Coast Highway

brief: A 2003 Craftsman-style clifftop resort: long three-storey wings of cream-painted shingle and board siding with white trim, low-pitched grey hipped and gabled roofs with deep eaves, bracketed balconies, loggias and window bays, stepping round lawns and two pool terraces down a coastal bluff above a rocky cove and beach, with a public clifftop path and stairs. Four photos (aerial and grounds). Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
